summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat at Foley Meir in a frustrating encounter where they created chances but couldn't capitalize on them. Saul Shotton pulled one back late with a fine volley, but it wasn't enough to salvage the result after The Bach conceded soft free kicks and struggled with defensive marking in the first half. The team will look to bounce back when they host Stafford Town on Saturday.
